scope: Numbered front covers 1–6, 6-1 and 6-2; retained development trials, photographic seeds, separate illustrations, generated sources, sticker pair, revision 07 back, fonts, recipes and comparisons.
status: Source preservation register requested by John; restoration received positively, not installed over saved Version 6-2.
path_base: Repository root; local paths remain portable when the repository folder moves.
preservation_rule: Keep originals and frozen versions; make edits in new files. Do not delete generated_images references as temporary output. Update this register explicitly for new sources; do not blindly rebaseline changed hashes.
exact_reproduction: Copy the saved frozen file. Prompts describe generative lineage but cannot reproduce identical pixels. Build scripts may recreate compositions but can overwrite canonical version paths; inspect and redirect before use.
coverage_method: Inventory scoped development directories and explicitly named existing local references; inspect build literals. Not a proof of automatic dependency closure or an independent backup.

known_layer_gaps: Cream V1 working master now separates photographs, background, graphic lettering, ribbon and stickers. Lettering remains raster artwork, not native font text.
Older saved covers remain flattened. The cream master contains a separately movable YouTube badge and an editable SVG yellow ribbon; those do not retroactively alter the saved 6-series masters.
Traditional and Metric sticker originals share one transparent raster sheet. The cream master extracts its Traditional sticker; separate vector originals do not exist.
Native cover photography remains 1100 x 1430 pixels, about 151 dpi at 185 x 240 mm. The working master is not a print-ready production approval.
